relationships.subject: alpha7 nicotinic acetylcholine receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: During the inflammation caused by LPS, activated α7nAChR can inhibit the M1 polarization of microglia and promote its transformation to the M2 type

relationships.subject: alpha7 nicotinic acetylcholine receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: natural acetylcholine (ACh) attaches to α7nAChR on microglia, triggering the JAK2/STAT3 signaling pathway, blocking NF-κB signal transduction, and decreasing the production of inflammatory cytokines like TNF-α and IL-1β

relationships.subject: M1 microglia
relationships.evidence_quote: especially the M1 phenotype, which releases pro-inflammatory substances like tumor necrosis factor-α (TNF-α), interleukin-1β (IL-1β), and interleukin-6 (IL-6)

key_findings: Review: neuroinflammation induces microglial ferroptosis and ferroptosis in turn exacerbates microglial inflammation in neuropathic pain.
Microglial alpha7nAChR activation suppresses M1 polarization and pro-inflammatory cytokines and may be a shared target for ferroptosis and neuroinflammation.
